HomeFAQ
FAQ

Questions

The questions a clinic manager asks before the first order.

01How are peptide lots stored and handled?

As laboratory practice: Supplied lyophilised (freeze-dried). Store sealed at −20 °C and protect from light. For in-vitro work, reconstitute with sterile or bacteriostatic water added slowly down the vial wall — do not shake; swirl until dissolved. Refrigerate (2–8 °C) once reconstituted and avoid repeated freeze–thaw.

02What purity does AXIOM hold?

Every peptide lot is analysed by HPLC / MS to confirm identity and a purity at or above ≥ 98%. A Certificate of Analysis accompanies each lot, and a sample is published on the standard page.

03How does delivery work?

Peptide lots are dispatched temperature-managed in tamper-evident packaging. Delivery is charged per consignment, Rp 100.000 per three units per destination and capped at Rp 300.000 per destination, and the charge is shown in the basket before you submit.

04How is payment made?

By bank transfer in Indonesian rupiah, before dispatch. Accepting a quote creates the order and its invoice together; the invoice is an Indonesian tax document.

05How long is a quote valid?

7 days from the day it is sent. The prices on a sent quote do not move in that window.

06Why are peptide prices not shown to everyone?

Education is public. Commerce, including price, follows a recorded acknowledgement that the buyer is eighteen or older and a qualified researcher or institutional buyer. The acknowledgement is valid for twelve months.

07Which products are consumer products?

Therapy devices and apparel are ordinary consumer products. Peptides are supplied strictly for in-vitro laboratory research and are not for human or veterinary consumption, diagnosis or treatment.

08Does AXIOM provide usage guidance?

No. AXIOM does not provide dosing, administration or usage guidance of any kind, in any channel. The compound guide describes identity, handling and verification only.

HomeThe standardHow to read a CoA
Explainer

How to read a Certificate of Analysis

A Certificate of Analysis is the document that separates a verified lot from a claim. This is what each line means, and what to check it against.

01

The compound and the lot code

The certificate names one compound and one lot. The lot code on the certificate must match the code on the vial label. A certificate without a lot code describes nothing in particular.

02

The method

High-performance liquid chromatography separates the sample and reports how much of it is the named compound. Mass spectrometry confirms that the compound is the one named, by its mass. A certificate that carries one without the other has confirmed purity without identity, or identity without purity.

03

The purity figure

Purity is the share of the sample that is the named compound, by chromatographic area. AXIOM holds a threshold of ≥ 98% and does not list a lot below it. A figure is only as good as the method and the date beside it.

04

The mass

The observed mass should sit close to the expected mass of the molecule. A large gap means the sample is not what the label says. AXIOM prints only a mass that was measured, never one copied from a reference.

05

The date and the issuer

A certificate is issued on a date, for a lot received on a date. An old certificate re-used for a new lot is the most common form of a false document.

06

What a certificate cannot tell you

It says nothing about what a compound does, how it is used or whether it is lawful to hold in your territory. It documents a lot. Everything else is a separate question.

AXIOM processes personal data under Law No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection (UU PDP). This notice states what is collected, why, for how long, and the rights that attach to it.

The controller is the AXIOM entity named on the invoice. Requests concerning personal data are answered through the WhatsApp line on the contact page.

Name, clinic or institution, role, email address and WhatsApp number, given on the request form or at sign-in; the contents of quotes, orders and invoices; the delivery addresses of an account's sites; and the acknowledgement record described below.

3. The acknowledgement record is personal data

The acknowledgement that a buyer is eighteen or older and a qualified researcher is recorded with the person's identity, the version of the text acknowledged, the time, and the network address and browser from which it was given. It is personal data under UU PDP and is processed on the basis of performing the contract of supply and of AXIOM's legal obligations.

The acknowledgement record is retained for the twelve months of its validity and for five years after it lapses, because it evidences the basis on which research compounds were supplied. 5. Sharing

Personal data is shared with the carrier for delivery, with the bank for payment reconciliation and with the tax authority as an invoice requires. It is not sold and not shared for advertising.

6. Rights

Under UU PDP a person may ask what personal data AXIOM holds about them, ask for it to be corrected or deleted, withdraw consent where processing rests on consent, and object to processing. A request is answered within the period the law sets. Deletion does not extend to records AXIOM is required to keep.

7. Cookies and storage

The site sets a cookie for the language, one for the basket and one for the session. It does not set advertising or tracking cookies.

8. Changes

This notice is revised when the processing changes. The date of the current revision is shown below.
